زَاعِبٌ A torrent driving along, one portion of it impelling another; (A, TA;) as also ↓ زَعُوبٌ [but app. in an intensive sense; and ↓ مُزْلَعِبٌّ , also, has the same, or a similar, meaning]: or the first and ↓ second signify a torrent filling the valley: and the first is also applied to rain, as meaning filling everything. (TA.) ―
-b2- Also A guide of the way, one who is a frequent traveller. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
